content.text:
**Finding: deviation (high) — § 13.1 licence grant scope**

The Services grant in § 13.1 licenses "Customer alone," expressly excludes Affiliates and contractors with no path to add them, and is "revocable at Vendor's sole discretion" — the rule's walk-away scenario. § 13.2's perpetual/irrevocable Affiliate-and-contractor grant is confined to paid-up software and embedded Deliverables, and § 13.3 fixes transferability and revocation but not Affiliate/contractor use, so even the fallback is not met.

Redline validated (ok:true) and finding submitted: § 13.1 now grants the licence to "Customer, its Affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf," with revocation limited to the notice-and-cure standard already agreed in § 13.3. Successor transfer needed no change, as § 13.3 already permits it.
